
gpu/gpu-dma-rdpoll2
Q poll, four times (cycles, from CHCR2's store to the poll's end; Timer 2 at the system clock / 8) and the poll's turns, of an
8,192-word read of 128x128 at (0,256) by DMA2 in 16-word blocks, the display off. Polls: N<n> CHCR2 then n nops; T + a Timer 2
read; S1 / S2 + one / two RAM stores; T1 / T2 + a Timer 2 read and one / two RAM stores; L2 + two RAM loads. No assertions.
